description: This is an Android activity class for a Nearby Service Discovery (NSD) chat application, managing service registration, discovery, connection, and messaging.

classes.name: NsdChatActivity
classes.description: Main Android activity for handling NSD chat functionality, including UI interactions and managing network services.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity UI, sets up the status view, and initializes the handler for chat message updates.

methods.name: clickAdvertise
methods.description: Handles user request to advertise/register a service via NSD.

methods.name: clickConnect
methods.description: Connects to a selected discovered service.

methods.name: clickSend
methods.description: Sends a chat message to the connected service.

methods.name: addChatLine
methods.description: Appends a new chat message to the chat display.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Initializes the connection and NSD helper when the activity starts.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Stops service discovery when the activity is paused.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Resumes service discovery when activity is resumed.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Cleans up NSD and connection resources when the activity stops.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the activity is destroyed.
